name: High-Dimensional Classification with Color Data
definition: A method for classifying color volume data by assigning opacity based on a classification function that uses RGB values, neighbor colors, and position, avoiding the difficulty of specifying 3D transfer functions for RGB data.
summary: High-Dimensional Classification with Color Data assigns opacity to RGB volumes using a 24-dimensional feature vector of color, neighbors, and position, allowing direct classification without transforming data into a derived space.
